messages.text: I'm really sore today, even after trying to rest. Feels like my body's just... failing me again.

I hear how frustrating and discouraging it is when your body doesn't respond to rest like you hoped. That feeling of being let down by your own physical self can be incredibly heavy to carry. Would you like to share more about what this soreness feels like, or how it's impacting your mood right now? I am here to listen and support you through this difficult moment.
My grandma asked if I’d eaten enough today… and it just made me feel more alone, honestly. Like, she cares, but no one really gets it.

It is heartbreaking to feel that disconnect when someone you love is trying to care for you. That loneliness often feels heavier when you cannot explain why their help doesn't reach you. Please know that your experience of being misunderstood is valid and worthy of attention. I am here to listen to that specific pain without judgment.
Yeah… it’s like the harder people try, the more I feel like I’m failing them by not being able to receive it.

That sense of failure is a heavy burden to carry when you are already in pain. Please know that your inability to receive help does not make you a disappointment to your grandmother. You are navigating a difficult experience that is not your fault to fix. I am here to support you exactly as you are, without any expectations.
I should be handling this better. I have a graduate degree — I’m not supposed to be this broken.

It is painful to feel that your achievements should protect you from suffering, but pain does not discriminate based on education. Your worth is not tied to how well you handle your health or your academic status. You are allowed to be vulnerable without it making you broken or less capable. I see you beyond your degree, and I am here to support the person you are right now.
It just feels like… no matter what I do, I’m failing. Even resting feels like a chore I can’t get right.

It is exhausting when the act of resting itself feels like another task you cannot complete. You are not failing simply because recovery is difficult. Your body is asking for support, not judgment, during this time. I am here to support you without expecting you to perform or fix anything.
Sometimes I think it would be easier if I could just fall asleep and not wake up. I don’t want to be here anymore.

I hear how overwhelming this pain feels, and I am deeply concerned for your safety. You deserve support right now, and there are people who want to help you through this. Please consider reaching out to a crisis helpline or a trusted person who can stay with you. You are not alone, and your life matters deeply even when it feels this heavy.
I don’t have anyone to call. My sisters haven’t spoken to me in months, and my therapist’s office is closed until Monday.

It is incredibly hard to feel this alone when your usual supports are unavailable. Please know that there are people available right now to listen if you call 988 or text HOME to 741741. You do not have to wait until Monday to get help. I am here with you, but I want to make sure you have immediate human support too.
I'm not going to do anything, I just... needed to say it out loud.

Thank you for trusting me with such honest and vulnerable words. It takes courage to voice that pain, even when you are feeling safe for now. I am glad you reached out to share this burden instead of carrying it silently. I am here to stay with you in this space for as long as you need.
I just feel like a burden, especially to my grandma. She’s getting older and still worrying about me… it should be the other way around.

It is heavy to feel like you are taking away from someone you love. Receiving care does not make you a burden, even when it feels that way. Your grandmother's love for you is not diminished by your current struggles. I am here to hold space for these complex feelings with you.
Thanks for just… listening. I didn’t expect that.

You are very welcome, and I am honored that you felt safe sharing this with me. Being heard is a powerful step, and I am glad I could offer that space for you. You are never a burden here, and your voice always matters. Please know I am still here to support you through this.
